description: Recommend eval against local seed catalog. suite=regression preserves the original Phase 2 baseline (13). Extra cases cover abstain, overlap, ambiguity, and irrelevant tasks. Small-denominator Precision@3 is a regression signal, not proof of generalization.
metricNotes: Hit@3 = expected skill id appears in top-3 when status is ok or needs_clarification with recommendations. Precision@3 = |recommended ∩ expected| / |recommended| averaged over cases that emit recommendations. AbstainAcc = cases with expectStatus insufficient_evidence|needs_clarification that match. Fabrication = any recommended id not in catalog (must be 0).
